 form.addEventListener('submit',e=>{
  if(e.defaultPrevented)return;
  const selected=[...form.querySelectorAll('input[name="aplicar[]"]:checked')];
  const rows=selected.map(el=>({id:el.value,ubicacion:form.querySelector('input[name="ubicacion['+el.value+']"]')?.value??''}));
  let hidden=form.querySelector('input[name="aplicar_json"]');if(!hidden){hidden=document.createElement('input');hidden.type='hidden';hidden.name='aplicar_json';form.append(hidden);}hidden.value=JSON.stringify(rows);
  form.querySelectorAll('input[name="aplicar[]"],input[name^="ubicacion["]').forEach(el=>el.removeAttribute('name'));
 });
})();
</script>

<script>
// GYD_REVISION_JSON_V1
(()=>{const form=document.querySelector('input[name="accion"][value="revisar"]')?.form;if(!form)return;
 form.addEventListener('submit',e=>{
   if(e.defaultPrevented)return;
   const map=new Map();
   const re=/^(aceptada|faltante|danada|caducada|equivocada|lote|caducidad|nota)\[(\d+)\]$/;
   for(const el of form.querySelectorAll('input[name]')){
      const m=el.name.match(re);if(!m)continue;
      const row=map.get(m[2])||{id:m[2]};if(!el.disabled)row[m[1]]=el.value;
      map.set(m[2],row);
   }
   let hidden=form.querySelector('input[name="revision_datos_json"]');if(!hidden){hidden=document.createElement('input');hidden.type='hidden';hidden.name='revision_datos_json';form.append(hidden);}
   hidden.value=JSON.stringify([...map.values()]);
   form.querySelectorAll('input[name]').forEach(el=>{if(re.test(el.name))el.removeAttribute('name');});
 });
})();
</script>
